## About

I hold a **MSc (2020) and BSc (2019) in Microbiology from Jahangirnagar University**. 
Alongside my professional work, I am developing my expertise in **bioinformatics and computational biology**.  My long term goal is to bridge **dry-lab computation and wet-lab biology** by using experimental knowledge and biological data together to understand disease mechanisms and contribute to the **Human Health**.
